issues.on_page: Schedules 1-2 print both 'Actual on GAAP Basis' and 'Actual on Budgetary Basis' columns
issues.issue: The extractor took the GAAP actual column, which ties to the statement, over the budgetary actual. This is a defensible assumption and is stated in notes. Lines with a '-' GAAP actual but a nonzero budget were left out (General Warrants Issued/Retired, budget 186,000/(197,447); Debt Service Engineering, Fiscal Agent Fees and Professional Fees, budget 5,000/2,500/2,500).
